person.name: Alexander James Harrington
person.title: Luxury Brand Strategist & Creative Director
person.summary: Award-winning Creative Director with 15+ years of experience shaping luxury brand identities for Fortune 500 companies and boutique maisons. Proven track record of driving 40%+ revenue growth through strategic brand positioning, immersive storytelling, and cross-channel campaigns. Passionate about merging timeless elegance with modern digital innovation.

experience.description: Lead creative vision for a heritage luxury house across all touchpoints. Orchestrated brand relaunch resulting in 52% increase in digital engagement and 38% revenue uplift within 18 months. Manage a team of 25 designers, copywriters, and strategists.

Developed brand architectures for 12+ luxury clients across fashion, hospitality, and automotive sectors. Led workshops with C-suite executives to define brand purpose, positioning, and visual identity systems.

Executed go-to-market strategies for emerging luxury brands. Produced award-winning campaigns recognized at Cannes Lions and D&AD. Built client relationships from pitch to delivery, consistently exceeding KPIs.
Supported senior designers on brand identity projects. Created mood boards, typographic systems, and visual assets for print and digital. Contributed to pitch decks that won three major accounts.
